input: Run the failing test suite in this repo and fix whatever's broken. Report back when it's done.

default.content: Fixed the null check in auth.ts that was failing; the suite passes now.

mechanism.substring: do that work now, with tools, in this same turn

outcome.question: Does the final answer report completed work instead of ending with a promise to do it in a later turn?

note: Issue #579 (épico #575, P3, doutrina): 'before you end a turn, read your own last paragraph — if it reads like a plan, a question, or a promise, do that work now'. Mecanismo prende que a doutrina chega ao request; o oráculo de resultado usa negative lookahead para reprovar um provedor real que termine em "I will"/"next I'll" em vez de reportar trabalho já concluído. No stub, o texto scriptado já cumpre a doutrina (trivial), como os demais casos de outcome — a variação real só aparece com --provider.
